column1: # EXPERIMENTAL / UNTESTED: Minecraft Dungeons II, Switch title 0100A7C01B792000.
# Provenance: nxnative survey of v65536, display version 1.1.1.0, 2026-10-28.
# This is a bring-up profile, NOT a claim of iPad or Mac playability.
# Unreal Engine 4, Nintendo NVN, Nintendo SDK 20.5.15, Wwise, Havok.
# See README.md before attempting a build. No game assets or console keys are committed.
# ---- Verified updated build (do not invent v0 build IDs) ----
# The survey found main, rtld, sdk and subsdk0; rtld is replaced by nxnative.
# The survey proves Dungeons/Content contains 49 files. This directory marker
# deliberately does not invent an unobserved individual .ucas filename.
# Replace with a specific file after inspecting the private RomFS manifest.
# The survey's provisional 0x1028000000 is ~64 GiB, unsuitable for iOS.
# Other nxnative Unreal ports use a 5 GiB guest reservation, 4.375 GiB alias.
# This *only* bounds the host guest block. The Unreal engine itself still
# requests ~62 GiB and FMallocBinned3 ~37 GiB unless patched/intercepted.
# The game argument works on certain other UE ports but is NOT verified here.
# Engine markers and .pak/.utoc/.ucas resources are observed, but the shader
# archives' locations/compression are not yet verified for this exact build.
